questions.H1: Does decomposing a multi-utterance STT segment into pieces raise gold-context recall over the raw-text query?
questions.H2: Do per-piece candidate guarantees (RRF, TOPN_EQUAL, UNION_A3) raise recall at small K over MAX fusion?
questions.LONG_RANGE: How often do independently labelled long-range references (type C) occur among nominated candidates, and how well do A0, A2 and A3 recover them?

frozenBefore: nominating, labelling or retrieving on any R2-B video; results never feed back into these rules

data.videos: 3 new videos from channels not used in P0, P1, the Far challenge set or R2-A, chosen at video level before reading transcripts; same Groq STT path; transcripts frozen

nomination.model: gpt-6-luna, reasoning_effort high, JSON mode, tools/far_nominations.py
nomination.budget: at most 20 candidates per video, one nominator call per video, no reruns

data.labels: T1 v2, Topic and T2 by tools/ai_labels.py on the nominated targets; labellers never see nomination reasons, expected context, eligibility, types or retrieval results, and are not told the study purpose
data.stopRule: evaluate exactly this budget; report the counts that occur; never relax the rules to reach a target count

typeRules.basis: independent T2 gold context only; the nominator's expected context is never used for acceptance or typing
typeRules.order: applied in this order to context-necessary cases with gold not fully inside the frozen A0 set
typeRules.PREVIEW: target startMs below 180000 and every gold segment outside A0 starts at least 600000 ms after the target
typeRules.A0_PAGE_BOUNDARY: every gold segment outside A0 is within 60000 ms of the target (absolute gap between segment and target times)
typeRules.LONG_RANGE_REFERENCE: at least one gold segment outside A0 is more than 60000 ms from the target, and the case is not PREVIEW
typeRules.NEAR: context-necessary with every gold segment inside A0 (kept and reported, not a Far type)

split.step1: split after ?, ., !, or the ellipsis character followed by whitespace; trim; drop empty pieces
split.step2: if step1 gives fewer than 2 pieces and the text has at least 30 code points and at least 4 whitespace-separated words: k = min(4, ceil(codePoints / 30)); split the words into k contiguous chunks, sizes as equal as possible with earlier chunks one word longer when uneven
split.unsplit: otherwise one piece; such a target is not H1/H2-eligible
split.note: step2 is a deterministic length proxy for multiple utterances, not a detected utterance boundary

eligibility.H1_H2: context-necessary cases (any type, including NEAR) whose target gives at least 2 pieces under split-v2; reported with the count of eligible cases
eligibility.both: a case meeting both is reported in both analyses and flagged

retrieval.base: docs/experiments/retrieval-rules/far-challenge-r1.json (SHA-256 da6f541cf44a78a5277be399dec34d26829d1b0a2d20be1259069bf9eaf57208) for documents, models, scopes, fusion methods, ties, A3 and budgets
retrieval.changes: split-v2 replaces the r1 split; metrics add A3 top exposure
retrieval.topExposure: within the K=100 candidate list: share of gold segments in the first 5, 10 and 20 after A3 reranking, next to the same cut-offs of the A2 order
retrieval.scopes: FULL_VIDEO primary and PAST_ONLY secondary, as in r1

metrics.nomination: type yield = cases of each type / nominated candidates, with the valid-label denominator also shown; a hit rate of the nominator, not a recall over the video
metrics.retrieval: per eligible set: Recall@K (all gold and outside-A0 only, N/A when empty), All-context Recall@K, gold ranks, A3 top exposure; per type and per scope; percentages always with counts
metrics.notInThisRun: reference-label agreement with the judging model is a later, separate run

frequencyQuestion: if few LONG_RANGE_REFERENCE cases appear, report that frequency as a finding in its own right
